def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); sep=9
    sr=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in I[i])]
    sc=[j for j in range(w) if all(I[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in segs(h,sr):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in segs(w,sc):
            sub=Counter(I[x][y] for x in range(r0,r1) for y in range(c0,c1))
            others=[v for v,n in sub.items() if v!=sep and v!=3]
            if not others: row.append(3); continue
            m=max(sub[v] for v in sub if v!=sep)
            cands=[v for v in others if sub[v]==m]
            if len(cands)>1:
                # count of 5s vs other? use min by (count,v)
                best=min(cands,key=lambda v:(sub[v],v))
            else:
                best=cands[0]
            row.append(best)
        out.append(row)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input']:
    print(k, solve(G[k]))
